|translation='''Title:''' Luke's Hunting Rifle.

'''Card text:'''
Use 1 Force to deploy on Luke or Owen Lars. Or use 3 Force to deploy on a non-droid character (even if not a warrior). Use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny minus 1 exceeds ability. A creature is immediately lost if destiny plus 2 exceeds defense value.

'''Lore:'''
Czerka 6-2Aug2 type. Its long barrel lets it snipe distant targets without an expensive laser scope. The build is sturdy, but not as tough as a Tusken Raider's gaffi stick.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore transliterates Czerka as シザーカ and gaderffii as ガダフィの杖.
